We release anchor-op, a reproducible toolkit for target-grouped evaluation, identifiability checks, and matched-geometry positive controls for perturbation-response models.

summary.takeaway: 在当前的 Perturb-seq 筛选数据上，固定程序空间的加性输入编码无法泛化到新的扰动靶点，因此推断出的调控算子不应被解释为目标泛化的调控机制。
summary.methods: 在 Replogle K562 essential、Replogle RPE1 essential 和 Jost 2020 三个 Perturb-seq 筛选中评估固定程序空间加性输入；采用目标分组嵌套交叉验证，并设置匹配信噪比的线性真值正对照；比较逆算子预测和正向目标留出预测，涵盖随机 K562 靶点面板、过定 Jost 维度扫描、仅方向拟合、ridge 与 truncated-SVD 估计器以及五个线性真值集成。
summary.relevance: 该论文直接针对单细胞扰动响应建模的可泛化性，与单细胞扰动主题相关，为基于 Perturb-seq 的调控推断提供了评估基准和负面结果警示。
summary.caveat: 结论基于所测试的三个 Perturb-seq 筛选和特定线性加性输入模型，摘要未说明是否验证其他非线性模型或体内扰动数据；正向预测的结论存在数据集异质性。

papers.title: Impaired value estimation over space explains turn-induced freezing of gait in Parkinson's disease: A cortico-basal ganglia-inspired reinforcement learning model
papers.abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) gait is characterized by reduced walking speed, short shuffling steps, increased double stance time, and increased step time variability. The most debilitating symptom in PD is freezing of gait (FOG), a context-dependent locomotion arrest, mostly occurring while encountering turns, obstacles, and narrow pathways. FOG is more pronounced during turning, a complex task that challenges motor planning and execution. Here, we simulate this phenomenon using a computational model inspired by the cortico-basal ganglia circuitry, based on reinforcement learning (RL) principles. In the model, the agent was trained to learn a value profile while navigating a path that involved turning. To simulate PD conditions, we clamped the temporal difference (TD) error, typically associated with dopaminergic signaling. Our model results show that compared to healthy controls (HC), PD non-freezers and PD freezers exhibit a reduction in turning velocity and step length, alongside an attenuated compensatory step-width widening at the sharpest turn, more pronounced in PD freezers, who additionally show increased step time variability. These kinematic impairments worsen during tighter turns. Ultimately, this model implicates FOG as a problem of impaired estimation of value over space and could potentially represent a generalized deficit in gait impairments in PD.

summary.takeaway: 一个受皮层-基底节环路启发的强化学习模型表明，帕金森病冻结步态可被解释为空间价值估计受损，尤其在转弯时表现更明显。
summary.methods: 构建基于强化学习的计算模型，智能体在包含转弯的路径中学习价值分布；通过钳制时序差分（TD）误差模拟帕金森病条件，比较健康对照、帕金森非冻结者和冻结者的运动学特征。
summary.relevance: 该论文使用强化学习模型解释帕金森病冻结步态，与强化学习主题直接相关，展示了 RL 在运动障碍机制建模中的应用。
summary.caveat: 结论完全来自计算模拟，未使用真实患者数据或实验验证；摘要未报告模型参数拟合或与临床数据的定量比较。

papers.title: Born with an abstract code for number: evidence from cross-modal and cross-format neural adaptation in the first three days of life
papers.abstract: One of the most astonishing abilities documented in human newborns is their capacity to spontaneously match sets of items on the basis of their number, even when they are presented in different modalities (auditory and visual) and formats (sequential and simultaneous). These behavioural findings suggest that the newborn brain comes to life endowed with a system that encodes number in an abstract, supramodal format, but direct neural evidence for such a representation is lacking. Using high-density EEG and a frequency-tagging paradigm, we measured neural entrainment to periodically presented visual arrays that were either numerically congruent or incongruent with previously familiarized and concurrently presented auditory sequences in 21 newborns (0-3 days old). The amplitude of neural entrainment to the visual arrays provided a robust index of cross-modal numerical congruency: it was significantly reduced for numerically congruent relative to incongruent stimuli. This cross-modal and cross-format numerosity-specific repetition suppression effect provides evidence for an abstract code for number in the newborn brain, reinforcing the view that number constitutes a foundational dimension of human perception since birth.

summary.takeaway: 新生儿大脑在出生后前三天即表现出抽象数字编码，跨模态和跨格式的数值一致性会引发神经适应抑制。
summary.methods: 对 21 名 0-3 天新生儿使用高密度 EEG 和频率标记范式，测量视觉阵列的神经夹带，视觉阵列与先前熟悉并同时呈现的听觉序列在数值上一致或不一致。
summary.relevance: 该研究涉及跨模态数值表征，与跨模态理解与生成主题相关，为抽象跨模态编码提供神经证据。
summary.caveat: 样本量较小（21 名新生儿），仅测试视觉-听觉跨模态数值一致性；摘要未说明是否控制其他低水平刺激差异，且未涉及生成任务。

papers.title: Gene Regulatory Network Reconstruction to Decipher the Molecular Mechanisms Governing Bacteriocyte-Based Symbioses.
papers.abstract: Intracellular bacteria with beneficial roles for their hosts are present in more than 10% of all insect species. In intracellular nutritional symbioses, these symbionts are typically confined to specialized host cells known as bacteriocytes. Bacteriocytes are remarkable novel cells that arose independently and repeatedly across multiple insect lineages. They are fascinating structures, yet the molecular mechanisms regulating their development, function and even their evolutionary origins, remain largely unknown. Nonetheless, an important role for certain transcription factors in development and homeostasis of bacteriocytes has been highlighted by several studies, hinting at the importance of the transcriptional networks regulated by them. Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference facilitates discovery of regulatory interactions underlying complex biological processes, as first shown in the model species Drosophila melanogaster and subsequently successfully applied to several other insect species. Here, we propose de novo computational inference as a strategy to reconstruct GRNs of bacteriocytes. We propose that the pea aphid Acyrthosiphon pisum is best suited to establish the first comparative framework for reconstructing and analyzing GRNs that control bacteriocyte development, function and death. This framework in turn can serve for evo-devo studies, by extending these analyses to other aphids, to other hemipterans and, more broadly, to other insects harboring bacteriocytes.

summary.takeaway: 提出利用从头计算推断策略重建含菌细胞（bacteriocyte）的基因调控网络，以豌豆蚜 Acyrthosiphon pisum 作为首个比较框架。
summary.methods: 基于基因调控网络推断的计算方法，以豌豆蚜为模式物种，提出建立重建和分析控制含菌细胞发育、功能和死亡的 GRN 的比较框架，并可扩展到其他蚜虫、半翅目和昆虫。
summary.relevance: 该论文聚焦于 GRN 推断以解析含菌细胞共生机制，与 GRN / Regulon 主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要为观点/框架性文章，未提供新 GRN 推断结果或实验验证；具体计算方法和数据未在摘要中详述。

papers.title: Does Financial Speech Need Continual Learning Regularization? A Study of EWC and mini-KFAC on Earnings Call ASR
papers.abstract: Earnings call transcription presents a realistic continual learning scenario where Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are updated with new recordings but risk catastrophic forgetting of previously learned financial speech patterns. Adapting Whisper-small from a general-domain speech corpus to the Earnings22 benchmark reveals the opposite: all evaluated methods exhibit improvement on held-out financial speech from the same domain during adaptation rather than forgetting. This task complementarity makes regularization counterproductive. Nevertheless, when regularization is warranted, a layer-wise mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (mini-KFAC) approximation seems to achieve lower word error rates (WERs) and more stable optimization than standard diagonal Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC). The results suggest that task complementarity should be assessed before applying continual learning constraints, and prefer mini-KFAC EWC over diagonal EWC when needed.

summary.takeaway: 在财报电话会议 ASR 持续学习场景中，任务互补性导致正则化反而有害；若需正则化，mini-KFAC 近似比标准对角 EWC 表现更好。
summary.methods: 将 Whisper-small 从通用领域语音语料适配到 Earnings22 基准，评估 EWC 和 mini-KFAC 等持续学习方法；比较词错误率和优化稳定性。
summary.relevance: 该论文研究持续学习在金融语音识别中的应用，与持续学习主题相关，并检验 EWC 和 mini-KFAC 正则化效果。
summary.caveat: 结论基于单一 ASR 模型和 Earnings22 基准，摘要未报告统计显著性或多数据集验证；任务互补性的普遍性尚不明确。

papers.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

summary.takeaway: 提出首个具身模拟持续学习基准 EmbodiedCLBench，发现基础任务经验可稳定提升复杂任务表现，但提升不随学习样本数量扩展，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有效信息。
summary.methods: 构建具身模拟基准，以组合泛化为核心评估原则，测试多种智能体框架和学习方法，评估智能体能否先学习基础任务再重组技能解决未见复杂任务。
summary.relevance: 该论文直接评估具身智能体的持续学习能力，与持续学习主题高度相关，并提供基准资源。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体具身环境和任务类型，也未报告计算成本或失败原因分析；结论可能受基准设计限制。

papers.title: Forest-weighted causal correlation: A scalable framework for causal inference in ecological time series
papers.abstract: 1. Detecting causal relationships from ecological time series remains challenging because community dynamics are often nonlinear, high-dimensional, noisy, and strongly synchronized. These characteristics can reduce the reliability of existing causal inference methods and complicate the identification of ecological interactions in complex natural systems. 2. I introduce Forest-weighted Causal Correlation (FORCC), a machine-learning-based framework that infers directional causality from adaptive neighborhood structures learned by random forests. Rather than evaluating causal direction through cross-map reconstruction, FORCC quantifies directional dependence from the preservation of neighborhood structure using rank-based associations among forest-weight matrices. 3. Simulations of coupled nonlinear systems showed that FORCC accurately recovered causal direction while substantially reducing synchronization-induced false-positive detections relative to conventional convergent cross mapping. Chatterjee's {xi} exhibited the strongest resistance to synchronization-induced errors among the evaluated rank-based statistics. 4. Application to a 12-year marine community time series from Maizuru Bay, Japan, identified asymmetric relationships between individual taxa and community dynamics, revealing candidate driver-like and passenger-like roles that were not readily explained by seasonal synchrony alone. 5. By combining adaptive neighborhood learning with rank-based causal inference, FORCC provides a scalable framework for causal discovery in ecological time series. The method offers a practical tool for screening causal relationships, generating ecological hypotheses, and investigating complex interactions in multivariate natural systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出森林加权因果相关（FORCC）框架，利用随机森林学习的自适应邻域结构推断定向因果关系，在模拟中准确恢复因果方向并减少同步导致的假阳性。
summary.methods: 基于随机森林权重矩阵的秩关联量化方向依赖，替代交叉映射重建；在耦合非线性系统模拟中与收敛交叉映射比较，并应用于日本舞鹤湾 12 年海洋群落时间序列。
summary.relevance: 该论文属于因果推断方法，用于机制推理，与机制推理主题相关，适合生态时间序列的因果发现。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告模拟和单一海洋群落应用，未提供广泛基准比较或真实因果验证；方法在非生态领域的适用性未说明。

papers.title: Single-cell gene networks nominate IKZF1 as an Alzheimer's disease microglial regulator.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMicroglia drive neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet no approved therapy targets this compartment. Human genome-wide association studies consistently implicate innate immune loci in AD risk, establishing microglial transcriptional programs as therapeutically relevant but pharmacologically underexploited targets.ObjectiveWe sought to identify transcription factors (TFs) governing microglial state transitions computationally and to nominate structurally tractable drug repurposing candidates.MethodsWe applied trajectory inference (PAGA), pseudobulk DESeq2, pySCENIC gene regulatory network (GRN) inference, CellChat, and virtual screening of 1962 approved compounds to 236,002 microglial nuclei from 84 donors (SEA-AD atlas).ResultsIKZF1 was the sole target TF retained under cisTarget v10 motif constraints, with peak regulon activity in LateAD-DAM (pseudotime ρ = + 0.309) and replication in an independent bulk cohort (GSE95587; adjusted p = 0.004). CellChat identified SLIT2→ROBO2 from multiple neuron subtypes (predominantly inhibitory interneurons) as the top predicted pathway to microglia. Tafamidis (→IRF8) and diflunisal (→PPARG) were top virtual screening hits; all evaluated compounds failed the pre-specified selectivity threshold.ConclusionsIKZF1 is prioritized as a candidate late-disease microglial TF, supported by six convergent evidence dimensions including independent bulk replication. Tafamidis and diflunisal are low-confidence repurposing hypotheses requiring experimental validation.

summary.takeaway: 通过单细胞基因网络分析将 IKZF1 提名为阿尔茨海默病小胶质细胞调控因子，并提名 Tafamidis 和 diflunisal 为低置信度药物重定位假设。
summary.methods: 对 SEA-AD 图谱中 84 名供体的 236,002 个小胶质细胞核应用轨迹推断（PAGA）、pseudobulk DESeq2、pySCENIC GRN 推断、CellChat 以及 1962 种已批准化合物的虚拟筛选，并在独立 bulk 队列 GSE95587 中重复。
summary.relevance: 该研究使用 GRN 推断提名 AD 小胶质细胞调控因子，与 GRN / Regulon 主题直接相关，展示单细胞网络分析在疾病机制和药物重定位中的应用。
summary.caveat: IKZF1 为计算提名，需实验验证；所有评估化合物均未通过预设选择性阈值，药物重定位假设为低置信度；摘要未提供功能扰动实验。

papers.title: Mapping transcriptional responses to cellular perturbations with RNA fingerprinting.
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation dictionaries measure how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations, creating the opportunity to assign causal interpretations to observational data. We introduce RNA fingerprinting, a statistical framework that maps transcriptional responses from new experiments onto reference perturbation dictionaries. RNA fingerprinting learns perturbation representations, or "fingerprints," from single-cell data, then probabilistically assigns query cells to one or more candidate perturbations. We benchmark on ground-truth datasets, demonstrating accurate assignments at single-cell resolution, scalability to genome-wide screens, and the ability to resolve combinatorial perturbations. We demonstrate broad utility across diverse biological settings: identifying context-specific regulators of p53 under ribosomal stress, characterizing dose-dependent drug mechanisms of action, and uncovering cytokine-driven B cell heterogeneity during secondary influenza infection in vivo. Together, these results establish RNA fingerprinting as a versatile framework for interpreting single-cell datasets by linking cellular states to their underlying perturbations.

summary.takeaway: 提出RNA fingerprinting统计框架，将新实验的转录响应映射到参考扰动字典，实现单细胞分辨率下的扰动分配。
summary.methods: 从单细胞数据学习扰动表征（fingerprints），概率性地将查询细胞分配给一个或多个候选扰动；在ground-truth数据集上进行基准测试，并应用于多种生物学场景。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接针对单细胞扰动主题，提供将细胞状态与其潜在扰动联系起来的通用框架，有助于因果解释观测数据。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能数值、数据集名称或与其他方法的定量比较；主要验证基于ground-truth数据集，实际应用中参考字典的覆盖度和质量可能限制其分配准确性。
